model: Argos en→zh 1.9; CTranslate2 4.6.0 CPU-only Ruy build; SentencePiece 0.2.1
review_method: Human semantic review against the intent criteria recorded for each synthetic test sentence. The 26-item probe is intentionally weighted toward high-risk wording and is not a representative corpus or a statistically meaningful accuracy score.

assessment.method: Human semantic review against the intent criteria recorded for each synthetic test sentence. The 26-item probe is intentionally weighted toward high-risk wording and is not a representative corpus or a statistically meaningful accuracy score.
assessment.other_cases: No comparably high-impact semantic reversal observed in this small probe; grammar and punctuation still vary.

findings.issue: A rescheduled Monday meeting became a meeting held continuously from Monday through Friday; the changed appointment date became a date range.
The deadline and review date collapsed into “今天明天”, losing the before-5-p.m. condition.
The contrast between a 15% reduction and a final value of 15% was lost, though this distinction is essential for instructions.
The trigger “after the returned item is received” became “after the refund is received”; the event that starts the 30-day clock changed.
In a software context, the trial period became a court trial (“审判”).
The dollar symbol was rendered as Chinese yuan (“元”), which may change the currency.
“by Friday” became “星期五前”, whose strict-before-Friday reading can differ from a Friday deadline.
